name: FDM-Bench — G-code Detection
protocol: FDM-Bench v1 deterministic 16-file G-code anomaly task, temperature 0; subjective ratings and probability outputs are excluded.

explanation.en: The score is exact four-class accuracy on the fixed 16-file deterministic set.
explanation.zh: 分数是固定 16 个文件上的四分类精确准确率。

summary.en: FDM-Bench tests anomaly diagnosis from full fused-deposition-manufacturing G-code files.
summary.zh: FDM-Bench 测试模型根据完整熔融沉积制造 G-code 文件诊断打印异常的能力。

task_format.en: Given a G-code file and printer context, the model chooses normal, under-extrusion, over-extrusion, or spaghetti failure.
task_format.zh: 模型根据 G-code 文件和打印机 context，在正常、挤出不足、挤出过量或意大利面式失败中选择一个标签。
